summary: Examples of iptables: blocking an IP, redirecting port 80 to 8600, allowing established connections, allowing new SSH, IP ranges, ipset matches, DSCP marking, and creating or deleting a user-defined chain.
questions: How do I redirect port 80 to another port with iptables?
How do I allow SSH connections with Ansible iptables?
How do I block a single IP address?
How do I create and delete a custom chain?
How do I allow traffic from an ipset group?

answer_card.title: iptables examples (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.iptables: {chain: INPUT, source: 8.8.8.8, jump: DROP}
  become: yes
- ansible.builtin.iptables:
    table: nat
    chain: PREROUTING
    in_interface: eth0
    protocol: tcp
    match: tcp
    destination_port: 80
    jump: REDIRECT
    to_ports: 8600
- ansible.builtin.iptables: {chain: INPUT, ctstate: ESTABLISHED,RELATED, jump: ACCEPT}
- ansible.builtin.iptables:
    chain: INPUT
    protocol: tcp
    destination_port: 22
    ctstate: NEW
    syn: match
    jump: ACCEPT
- iptables: {chain: ALLOWLIST, chain_management: true}            # create
- iptables: {chain: ALLOWLIST, chain_management: true, state: absent}
```
